name: DeskLink
description: Your DeskLink phone in Quick Settings: how it is connected, its battery, quick actions (ring, lock, send files, send clipboard, keep awake), what it is doing on this computer with End, recent files and Lock & Hand Off. Its notifications appear as GNOME notifications, with replies, and a call ringing on it as a banner with Answer and Decline. On the lock screen it offers "Unlock with your phone" when you turned that on in DeskLink. Needs the DeskLink app.
